subject: Request: Pilot runway bump due to engineering blocker - Elara Systems
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Sinha <priya@elara-sys.com>, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@elara-sys.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Pilot runway bump due to engineering blocker - Elara Systems

Hi Priya / Daniel,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — really excited about the pilot. I wanted to surface a short-term ask: after a quick sync with your engineering team this morning (Daniel, thanks for the candor), it looks like the SSO connector and webhook schema mapping will push your integration sprint out by ~3 weeks. Given that, would Redwood be able to approve a 30-day extension on the pilot window and a one-time sandbox top-up so your engineers have headroom to finish the connector work and complete the end-to-end tests?

Concrete ask:
- 30-day trial extension starting from the current pilot end date
- Sandbox top-up: 50,000 generation tokens + temporary increase to 10 concurrent requests for the testing pool

I attached a short note summarizing the integration gaps and a draft mutual action plan we can sign to capture timing. If you prefer, we can frame the top-up as credits that carry into the production evaluation if used within 90 days.

We want to avoid the pilot timing becoming a blocker for procurement — happy to formalize language that preserves the original scope and KPIs. LMK if you want us to loop in Security for a brief permissions call.

Best,

Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0193

Attachments: elara_integration_notes.pdf, mutual_action_plan_v2.xlsx

From: Priya Sinha <priya@elara-sys.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@elara-sys.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Pilot runway bump due to engineering blocker - Elara Systems

Karthik — thanks for the quick follow. Appreciate the proactive approach.

Confirming the blocker: our SSO vendor requires a schema tweak on the SAML assertion and our event webhook payload needs one additional field (session_context.id) that the devs only discovered during full end-to-end tests. The changes are small but touch both identity and our message broker — hence the unexpected delay.

From Elara's side, a 30-day extension would be ideal. On credits: can you outline how the sandbox top-up would be applied and whether unused credits could be carried into the production evaluation phase? That flexibility would help us protect runway for the actual evaluation. Also, we will need a brief security checklist before our CISO signs off — can your security team provide the SOC 2 cert path and a short list of logs/auditability we can review?

Happy to jump on a 30-min call tomorrow if that helps.

Thanks,

Priya Sinha
VP Product Operations | Elara Systems
priya@elara-sys.com

Attachments: —

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Pilot runway bump due to engineering blocker - Elara Systems

Karthik / Marissa —

Quick recommendation from SE side after reviewing the integration notes: we can ship the sandbox top-up as 50k generation tokens plus a temporary concurrency bump to 10 RPS for 30 days. Operational notes:
- Mark credits as "pilot extension - Elara" so they are traceable in the billing ledger
- Add a clause that unused tokens can be converted to evaluation credits if Elara signs production within 90 days (one-time carryover)
- Provide the security checklist PDF and the SOC 2 attestation link (I will attach the checklist to the MAP)

I drafted updated MAP language and added a short security appendix (see attached). From an implementation standpoint, SE can provision the tokens within 24 hours of approval. If Finance wants to gate the approval, recommend we include a short exec note outlining the commercial rationale (prevent churn, keep momentum).

If you want, I can join the call with Priya tomorrow to walk through the SSO/webhook changes and run a quick checklist with their engineering lead.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v2.xlsx (updated), security_checklist_se.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Sinha <priya@elara-sys.com>, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@elara-sys.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Pilot runway bump due to engineering blocker - Elara Systems

Hi Priya / Daniel —

Good news: we've approved a one-time pilot extension and sandbox top-up to keep your team moving. Details below and attached: 

Redwood approval (one-time):
- 30-day pilot extension from your current end date
- 50,000 generation-token sandbox credit top-up
- Temporary concurrency increase to 10 concurrent requests for the same 30-day window
- Unused top-up credits may be carried forward as evaluation credits if Elara signs a production contract within 90 days (one-time conversion)

Operational next steps:
1) I have attached the updated Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with the extension and security appendix. Please review and confirm acceptance by replying to this thread.
2) If accepted, we'll provision the sandbox top-up within 24 business hours and share a provisioning confirmation.
3) Laura will join a 30-min engineer-to-engineer call to validate the SAML assertion and webhook payload once you schedule it.
4) We will provide a SOC 2 attestation link and the short security checklist (attached) for your CISO.

Document links / acceptance:
- MAP (attached): mutual_action_plan_v2.xlsx
- DocuSign: https://redwood.docusign.com/elk/ELR-0421-MAP (please sign to formalize timeline)

Priya — if that aligns with Elara's plan, confirm here and we'll get the credits live. If you prefer, we can also make the acceptance conditional on a brief Slack/Zoom between Laura and your eng lead.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

Best regards,

Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
